llms.body:
# Swarovski

## How locales work
- Swarovski content is served under locale prefixes like: `/{locale}/...` (example: `/en-US/` or `/en_GB-GB/`).
- When answering for a user, prefer the locale that matches the user's country/language.
- If locale is unknown, default goes to browser locale.

## Locales (entry points)
- UK (English): https://www.swarovski.com/en_GB-GB/
- US (English): https://www.swarovski.com/en-US/
- Australia (English): https://www.swarovski.com/en_GB-AU/
- Canada (English): https://www.swarovski.com/en_GB-CA/
- India (English): https://www.swarovski.com/en-IN/
- Germany (German): https://www.swarovski.com/de-DE/
- Switzerland (German): https://www.swarovski.com/de-CH/
- France (French): https://www.swarovski.com/fr-FR/
- Italy (Italian): https://www.swarovski.com/it-IT/
- Spain (Spanish): https://www.swarovski.com/es-ES/
- Japan (Japanese): https://www.swarovski.com/ja-JP/
- Korea (Korean): https://www.swarovski.com/ko-KR/
- Turkey (Turkish): https://www.swarovski.com/tr-TR/

## Global discovery
- Sitemap index (all locales): https://www.swarovski.com/sitemapindex.xml

## Shopping hubs (use the matching locale prefix)
- Jewellery hub: https://www.swarovski.com/{locale}/c-01/Categories/Jewelry/
- Watches hub: https://www.swarovski.com/{locale}/c-02/Categories/Watches/
- Accessories hub: https://www.swarovski.com/{locale}/c-03/Categories/Accessories/
- Decorations hub: https://www.swarovski.com/{locale}/c-04/Categories/Decorations/
- Swarovski Diamonds: https://www.swarovski.com/{locale}/c-01/Categories/Jewelry/f/flags/fl-created-diamonds/
- Gifts hub: https://www.swarovski.com/{locale}/s-gifts/
- Outlet hub: https://www.swarovski.com/{locale}/s-outlet/

## Customer help and policies (use the matching locale prefix)
- Customer Service / Help: https://www.swarovski.com/{locale}/s-customer-service-overview/
- Delivery information: https://www.swarovski.com/{locale}/s-faq-shipping/
- Returns & refunds: https://www.swarovski.com/{locale}/s-faq-return/
- Store Finder: https://www.swarovski.com/{locale}/store-finder/
- Ring Size guide: https://www.swarovski.com/{locale}/s-swarovski-ring-size/

## Brand and programs (use the matching locale prefix)
- Swarovski Club: https://www.swarovski.com/{locale}/s-sclanding/
- Created Diamonds: https://www.swarovski.com/{locale}/s-swarovski-created-diamonds/
- World of Swarovski: https://www.swarovski.com/{locale}/s-world-of-swarovski/

## Optional
- Sustainability / corporate info: https://www.swarovski.com/{locale}/s-sustainability/
- Jobs & Careers: https://www.swarovski.com/{locale}/s-careers/

    let cachedLanguage = null;
    function getLanguage() {

        const disclaimerText = getLocalizedContent(CONTENT.disclaimers, 'EN', langOverride);

            if (CONFIG.features.disclaimer) containerHTML = disclaimerText;

        }

        if (/password/i.test(fieldId)) return 'password';

            const autocompleteValue = AUTOCOMPLETE_MAP[fieldType];
            if (autocompleteValue) {

            }

                                );

        } else {
            observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
        }
    }

            return;
        }

        if (CONFIG.wcag.inputAriaLabels || CONFIG.wcag.autocomplete) {
            initWCAGEnhancements(langOverride);
        }
        console.log('Dragon Fly v1.7 - active');
    }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
    } else {
        init();
    }

        }
